Vik explicitly accepted the ordinary Loci graph-adoption Objective on 15 September 2026 with "OKay mark the objective as complete please". Manifest readback is complete:55/55 required leaves,3 discontinued, no Next or available work. The unrun complete-work preflight/campaign/analysis are discontinued; no measurement was invented or historical failed gate rewritten. Normal dogfooding and fixes to observed problems are the next operating mode, with no remaining required Task in this Objective.

The final acceptance Task is W1.8.4.4.10.3. W1.8.4.4.10.2.3, .10.2.4 and
.10.2.5 were discontinued with the user's scope correction. Their sandbox
failure and unperformed measurements remain history. The final acceptance
criterion was explicitly revised to reflect Vik's decision to close on the
implemented graph behavior and retained ordinary-call evidence.

This follows "build now -> dogfood -> cut and fix as needed". Graph invocation
and validated delivery are evidenced; exact total savings, model reliance and
complete-work comparison remain unproven, and no longer block this accepted
Objective. Completion is user acceptance, not a newly successful experiment.
Work remains on master; no new product change, branch move or code deletion ran.
